purpose: Compatibility regression guard for the original v1.0.0 math-modeling workflow. This is not a cryptographic security or anti-tamper guarantee.

approved_bugfix_reasons.config/pipeline.yaml: Fix invalid YAML syntax in recommendations[0] data-flow paths so the runtime can actually load the configuration.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/run_pipeline.py: Implement the quality gates already specified by v1.0.0; repair run modes, stage resume, --show-audit, --journal alias, and honest --no-ai-stub behavior.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/report.py: Prevent demo/missing-validation runs from being mislabeled submission-ready and make the optional post-S6 readiness preflight authoritative when present.
approved_bugfix_reasons.scripts/validate.py: Align Finding output with validation.schema.json and correct PASS_WITH_WARNINGS verdict logic so G6 can evaluate real findings.
approved_bugfix_reasons.prompts/README.md: Synchronize the prompt inventory with the additive SCI extension and its publication-readiness routing while preserving the legacy workflow.

protected_semantics: original math-modeling S1-S7 workflow remains available
all original manuscript figures and figure references must be preserved during conversion unless author-approved
all original tables and table references must be preserved during conversion unless author-approved
equations, symbols, definitions, constraints, numerical results, units and uncertainty must not be silently altered
core conclusions and key scientific arguments must not be silently strengthened, weakened, removed or invented
missing evidence and unverified references must remain explicit rather than being fabricated
